diff --git a/src/models/player.py b/src/models/player.py
--- a/src/models/player.py
+++ b/src/models/player.py
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 class Player:
     def __init__(self, player_id: str, name: str, source: str = "unknown") -> None:
+        # Domain identity model participates in repository/factory flow.
         self.player_id = player_id
         self.name = name
         self.source = source

diff --git a/src/models/identity.py b/src/models/identity.py
--- a/src/models/identity.py
+++ b/src/models/identity.py
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 class ExternalIdentity:
     def __init__(self, provider: str, external_id: str, normalized: bool = True) -> None:
+        # External identity is shared by persistence and factories.
         self.provider = provider
         self.external_id = external_id
         self.normalized = normalized

diff --git a/src/models/team.py b/src/models/team.py
--- a/src/models/team.py
+++ b/src/models/team.py
@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
 class Team:
     def __init__(self, team_id: str, sport: str = "football") -> None:
+        # Unreferenced sibling control.
         self.team_id = team_id

diff --git a/src/repositories/player_repository.py b/src/repositories/player_repository.py
--- a/src/repositories/player_repository.py
+++ b/src/repositories/player_repository.py
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 from src.models.player import Player
+from src.models.identity import ExternalIdentity

 class PlayerRepository:
-    def save(self, player: Player, identity_id: str) -> str:
-        return player.player_id

-def make_player(player_id: str, name: str) -> Player:
